description: This line plot illustrates the BLEU scores for four different models—Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE-MP, and Consistency-Bi—as a function of the Average Lagging (AL) value, which ranges from 2 to 8 on the x-axis and is presented on a linear scale. The y-axis represents the BLEU score, ranging from 20 to 32, also on a linear scale. The Consistency-CE model is represented by a magenta dashed line with diamond markers, starting at a BLEU score of approximately 19.0 at AL=2 and increasing to about 31.5 at AL=8. The Inconsistency-CE model is shown as a dark purple solid line with square markers, beginning at approximately 22.5 at AL=2 and rising to about 30.5 at AL=8. The Inconsistency-CE-MP model is depicted with a blue dashed line and square markers, starting at approximately 22.0 at AL=2 and reaching about 31.5 at AL=8. The Consistency-Bi model is indicated by a red solid line with star markers, beginning at approximately 25.8 at AL=2 and increasing to about 32.0 at AL=8. All lines show an upward trend as AL increases, with the Consistency-Bi model consistently achieving the highest BLEU scores across the entire range of AL values.
